# Changelog

Notable changes to w3develops.org, newest first. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/). The site deploys
from `main` continuously, so changes are grouped by date rather than version.
Pull request numbers refer to [JonDevOps/w3Develops](https://github.com/JonDevOps/w3Develops/pulls),
where work is merged before it's synced to [w3develops/w3Develops](https://github.com/w3develops/w3Develops).

When you open a pull request, add a line under **Unreleased** saying what
changed for members, in plain words.

## Unreleased

## 2026-11-11

### Added
- Community feed: @mentions in posts and replies, with notifications (#18).
- Community feed: edit your replies, and appeal hidden replies (#17).
- Community feed: "Load more" for posts older than the newest 50 (#16).
- Community feed: follow requests for private accounts, likes, replies,
  in-site appeals, and moderator alerts in the notification bell (#15).

## 2026-11-10

### Added
- Community feed: followers-only posts, private accounts, images, and
  automatic text and image safety checks (#14).
- Moderators can edit and delete members' study groups, projects, book
  clubs, meetups, competitions, jobs and solo projects, with a log (#13).
- The community feed (`/feed`) and its moderation page (`/moderation`) (#12).
- Scheduled w3Develops posts on 8 topics, shown on the news pages (#11).
- Our own Developer News Style Guide (#10).
- Members can add their Discord username to their profile (#9).
- Members can list their own mentorships, tutorships and pairings (#6).

### Changed
- Members can only change their own profile; connection lists moved off
  profiles (#7, #8).

## 2026-11-07 to 2026-11-08

### Fixed
- The podcast page falls back to the playlist player when YouTube's feed is
  down (#5).
- A hydration error on the home page (#3).

### Changed
- Pair programming runs on the shared matching program (#1).
- Plans and audits for removing hand-synced profile arrays (#2, #4).
